messages:
Ella Kim: Quick question — how are folks recommending clients handle sporadic 429s that happen mid-stream? We see users get a 429 ~20-30s into some long streams.
Matt Nguyen: Are these bursts tied to auth refreshes or sustained traffic? any logs/ids to repro?
Ella Kim: Mostly after token refresh windows, sometimes coincides with short traffic spikes. No clear repro yet.
Samir Patel: Two axes: 1) idempotency/side-effect safety, 2) resume support for streaming. If streams are pure read/append, treat 429 as transient and attempt resume.
Priya Shah: For non-streaming mutate APIs we require an idempotency-key. For streaming, best-effort resume with resume-token header is our pattern.
Matt Nguyen: Our SDKs default: exponential backoff with full jitter, cap at 60s, max attempts 5. Also add an initial fast-retry window (2-3 quick retries) for transient spikes.
Ella Kim: Example pseudo:
```
// on 429/5xx
await sleep(exp_backoff_with_full_jitter(attempt, cap=60000))
// for stream reconnect:
POST /v1/streams/resume
Header: x-resume-token: <token>
```
Samir Patel: Don't forget a total retry budget per logical request: e.g., 5 attempts or 120s total. Otherwise clients can hammer during partial outages.
Priya Shah: Docs note: keep idempotency-key records for 24h for server-side dedupe. Also include a timestamp + signature to detect stale keys.
Matt Nguyen: Language-specific gotchas: Go's net/http reuses connections aggressively — make sure Transport settings and IdleConnTimeout are sane, otherwise reconnects become stuck.
Samir Patel: In Python asyncio make sure reconnect tasks are awaited/cancelled to avoid accumulating background retries during flaky networks.
Ella Kim: Any guidance on classifying 429 vs 503 vs 5xx? When to treat as short-circuit vs retryable?
Priya Shah: 429 -> retryable with backoff + jitter; 503 -> depends on Retry-After header (honor it if present); 5xx -> retryable but with more conservative caps.
Matt Nguyen: For streams we also check for server-sent resume_token before failure; if present prefer resume flow rather than full restart.
Samir Patel: One more: expose retry metrics in SDKs (attempts, last_status, total_time) so customers can tune or surface alerts.
Ella Kim: Awesome. Can someone produce a short checklist we can link from the public SDK docs? @Priya @Matt
Priya Shah: I'll open a PR with: auth refresh grace, idempotency retention window, resume-token protocol, backoff defaults, honor Retry-After, sample snippets.
Matt Nguyen: I'll add language caveats for Go/Rust/Python and example client configs.
